intended_contract.operator_access: An authenticated principal holding the configured PORTIA_SYSTEM_ADMIN_ROLE can inspect status without app-auth boilerplate. Existing custom read policies may narrow that. Direct diagnosis and repair still require their explicit scoped operational policy.
intended_contract.source_progress: Native committed checkpoint is authoritative. Source cursors are opaque; gaps/expiry must not fabricate exact counts. Diagnostics are bounded.
intended_contract.lifecycle: Diagnostic listener outages must not stop processing. Ownership revocation prevents stale dispatch, and failed withdrawal must remain recoverable.

provider_facts.expiry: Fitz can omit expired entries while advancing the returned cursor. Resource metadata and subsequent reads can observe concurrent appends.
provider_facts.withdrawal: Native UnregisterAsync is retryable and reports failure. DisposeAsync swallows failure, so the registrar uses explicit UnregisterAsync.

configured_administrator_without_custom_.instructions: Does the status authorizer allow a configured administrator when IOperationalAuthorizer is absent?

existing_policy_can_deny_status.instructions: Does a registered operational policy that refuses Read still deny status access?

native_checkpoint_cannot_be_replaced.instructions: Does the status handler reject a source observation whose Position differs from the committed native checkpoint?

no_tenant_roster_refresh.instructions: Does status inspection avoid calling the tenant directory?

expiry_gaps_keep_partial_progress.instructions: Does the progress inspector preserve an observation with unknown exact count when readable offsets have ascending gaps?

resource_count_respects_sampled_head.instructions: Does resource progress counting exclude concurrent appends at or beyond the sampled exclusive source head?

nonzero_empty_checkpoint_validated.instructions: Does a nonzero empty pattern observation validate the checkpoint using a preceding-position read before calling it caught up?

diagnostic_registration_independent.instructions: Does the worker maintain status RPC registration in an independent task so failed subscription does not block event processing?

withdrawal_background_retry.instructions: Does the registrar retry failed native withdrawal in the background without requiring ownership reacquisition?

direct_operations_require_operator_role.instructions: Does the direct operations authorization guard require the configured administrator role before evaluating operational permissions?

admin_discovery_requires_operator_role.instructions: Does the administrative MCP request delegate enforce the configured administrator role before dispatching discovery or tool requests?

approval_permission_still_required.instructions: Does ApproveRepairAsync still require the distinct OperationalAccess.Approve permission?
